en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 147 - It is narrated from Ahmad bin Idris from Ali bin Muhammad Ibn Qutaibah from Fadhl bin Shazan from Muhammad bin Sinan from Ammar bin Marwan from Munakhal bin Jamil from Jabir Jofi from Imam Baqir (a.s) that he said: “
Mahdi is a man from the progeny of Fatima. He is of wheaten complexion.”
